day.rule: Most qualifying SFO rows on the local SFO day; ties by total movements, then earliest date

window.rule: Whole-hour local start with the most qualifying SFO movements; ties by movements, then earliest

wake_category_rule.value: HEAVY if scheduled stage length >= 2000 statute miles else MEDIUM
wake_category_rule.basis: Proxy only. Aircraft type is not in the source and a tail number alone does not establish it.

taxi_in_min.basis: Unimpeded taxi-in used to estimate scheduled wheels-on from scheduled gate arrival

taxi_out_min.basis: Unimpeded taxi-out used to estimate scheduled wheels-off from scheduled gate departure

holding_fuel_available_min.basis: Uniform seeded draw per arrival: airborne holding available beyond the estimated scheduled landing before final reserve. Not a fuel load. The 30 min floor is a typical contingency plus holding allowance; a 10 min floor made the historical slice unsequenceable

gate_dwell_cap_min.basis: Aircraft that arrived earlier than this before scenario start with no departure in the scenario are assumed towed off-gate

gate_assignment_buffer_min.basis: Added after each scheduled gate stay before another aircraft is given the same gate, so moderate delays do not create gate conflicts

gate_headroom_factor.basis: Simulated gate count = ceil(peak buffered gate demand x factor)

departure_gate_lead_min.basis: Member 1 engine starts a departure's gate reservation 20 min before scheduled departure; initial occupancy ends there

crew_duty_remaining_min.basis: Uniform seeded draw per aircraft rotation crew: remaining work limit

crew_availability_margin_min.basis: Crew available from scenario start until scenario end plus this margin

pushback_tugs.basis: Single shared ground equipment resource. The engine reserves it for every movement's taxi interval, arrivals included

taxi_speed_mps.basis: Minimum traversal time of a taxi segment = length / speed, at least 30 s

taxi_piece_max_m.basis: Taxi segments are split into equal pieces no longer than this

connections.basis: Passenger connections are not in the source. Same-airline arrival to departure pairs with a scheduled gap between 40 and 120 minutes are eligible; a seeded share is declared.

coverage_limits: Runways, runway crossings and taxiway names are SOURCED from FAA AL-375 (2026); taxiway topology, segment lengths, gates, crews and equipment are SYNTHETIC.
Taxiway graph is a bounded abstraction of AL-375: main parallels A, B, C, L, the M apron connector and four runway crossings. Many real connectors and holding bays are omitted.
Gate identifiers and counts are simulated; AL-375 shows boarding areas, not gates.
Parallel runway spacing and all coordinates are schematic.
Layout effective 2026-10-29 is paired with 2015 traffic.
BTS on-time data covers reporting carriers' scheduled domestic passenger legs only; international, cargo, general aviation and non-reporting regional traffic at SFO are absent.
Clock fields have one-minute resolution and no seconds.
No radar positions, runway, taxiway, gate or aircraft type are in the source rows.
October 2015 rows use numeric BTS airport IDs; without the BTS lookup they cannot be matched to SFO and October is excluded from day selection.
Time zone assignment per airport is curated and awaits review (see source_manifest.json).
